name: full stop
function: Marks the end of a statement or sentence
example: The cat sat on the mat.
usageTip: Place at the end of a sentence that makes a statement.

name: comma
function: Indicates a short pause or separates items in a list
example: I bought apples, bananas, and oranges.
usageTip: Use to separate clauses or items in a list.

name: question mark
function: Marks the end of a question
usageTip: Place at the end of a direct question.

name: exclamation mark
function: Indicates strong feeling or high volume
usageTip: Use sparingly to show emotion or emphasis.

name: apostrophe
usageTip: Use for contractions or to show ownership.

name: quotation marks
function: Indicates direct speech or a quotation
usageTip: Use around exact words spoken or quoted.

name: colon
function: Introduces a list, explanation, or quotation
example: You need three things: time, effort, and patience.
usageTip: Use after a complete sentence to introduce related information.

name: semicolon
example: I have a big test tomorrow; I can't go out tonight.
usageTip: Use to connect two sentences that are closely related.

name: hyphen
usageTip: Use to link words in compound adjectives or numbers.

name: parentheses
example: The conference (held in Sydney) was a success.
usageTip: Use to add non-essential information to a sentence.

name: ellipsis
function: Indicates omitted words or a trailing off of thought
usageTip: Use to show a pause or incomplete thought.

name: forward slash
example: Please write your name and/or signature.
usageTip: Use to mean 'or' or to separate parts of a fraction.
